name: Beauty by Sambina – BBS Brow & Skin Studio
h1: Brows, lashes and skin, *by an Aveda Master Esthetician.*
lead: Combo brows, lash lifts, lash sets and facials on South Brewer Street. Rated 5 stars by 37 Google reviewers.
about: Samantha Hammock runs Beauty by Sambina, a brow and skin studio in Navasota. She trained as an Aveda Master Esthetician in 2023.
Every combo brow starts with a consultation and patch test, and she believes most of your skin results come from what you do at home every day.
services: Microblading plus shading for a bolder, natural look. Includes a 6-week touch-up.
A lift for your natural lashes.
